claim_text: Deichmann says unauthorised persons gained access to selected customer data from its online shop
summary: Deichmann says it found an IT security incident in which "unauthorised persons gained access to selected customer data relating to purchases in our online shop".
detail: The German notice (dated Nov 24) covers the online shop of Deichmann SE; matching notices cover the UK shop (Deichmann-Shoes UK, Nov 24) and the Austrian shop (Deichmann GmbH, Nov 25).
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Deichmann's own notices on its German, UK and Austrian shop websites say so in these words.

claim_text: Deichmann says it stopped the access and closed the vulnerability that was used
summary: Deichmann says: "We have stopped the access and closed the vulnerability that was exploited." It has not said what the vulnerability was or in which system.
detail: heise notes that Deichmann does not say what the vulnerability was or which software or hardware it was in.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The notices say it; heise reports that the weakness was not described.

claim_text: Deichmann has not said when the access happened, how many customers are affected, or who was behind it
summary: Deichmann calls the scope "limited" but gives no number and no dates for the access. Nobody has been named as responsible.
detail: The dpa report says the company did not say how many customers are affected.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The notice gives no count or dates; the dpa report says the number was not disclosed.

claim_text: Names, addresses, invoices, email addresses, phone numbers and the chosen payment method may be affected
summary: Deichmann lists the data that may be affected: first and last name, billing and delivery address, invoices, email address, phone number and the chosen payment method (for example credit card or PayPal).
label: Confirmed

claim_text: Deichmann says passwords, account logins and payment data such as card numbers were not affected
summary: Deichmann says passwords and login details for customer accounts are not affected, and nor are payment data such as credit card numbers or PayPal login details.
detail: The data that may be affected includes which payment method a customer chose, but not the card number or PayPal login.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The notices say so in these words.

claim_text: Deichmann says the scope is limited and it has no sign the data has been misused
summary: Deichmann says: "The scope of the incident is limited. We currently have no indication that the data has been misused."
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The notices say it; the dpa report quotes it.

claim_text: Deichmann's subsidiary Snipes is also affected, according to a spokesperson quoted by dpa
summary: The news agency dpa reports that the Deichmann subsidiary Snipes is also affected; a spokesperson said affected customers would be informed directly.
detail: Snipes is a sneaker and streetwear retailer owned by Deichmann. We have not found a Snipes notice of its own.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The dpa report, as carried by the Lippische Landes-Zeitung, says so and quotes the spokesperson.

claim_text: Deichmann says it has informed the authorities, filed a criminal complaint and is working with outside security experts
summary: Deichmann says it informed the responsible authorities, filed a criminal complaint, and is investigating with external security experts.
detail: It has not named the authorities.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The German notice says so; the dpa report repeats it.

claim_text: Deichmann is emailing customers who may be affected and warns of fake messages that use real order details
summary: Deichmann will email customers whose data may be affected. It warns that criminals could pose as Deichmann by email, letter or phone using real order details, and says it never asks for passwords or payment data.
label: Confirmed

claim_text: heise reports the breach and says Deichmann has not described the weakness
summary: heise online reported on Nov 25 that criminals had apparently got into Deichmann's IT systems and accessed customer data, citing the company's notice.
label: Reported
